claims: Michigan opened as a 7.5-point favorite over UConn for the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball National Championship.
The 7.5-point line holding steady across BetMGM, DraftKings, and FanDuel.
The over/under for the game is set at approximately 144.5 to 145.5 points.
The game time is Monday, April 6, 2026, 8:50 p.m. ET.
The game is broadcast on TBS, TNT, truTV.
The matchup features No. 1 seed Michigan against No. 2 seed UConn in Indianapolis.
The public initially backing Michigan to cover the spread.
